visual_features: Elongated, slender cylindrical green pods, smooth or slightly bumpy surface, tapered ends, pliable flesh enclosing small developing seeds.
growth_habit: Bush beans (determinate, self-supporting) or pole beans (indeterminate, climbing twining vines requiring trellises).
nutritional_profile: Rich in dietary fiber, Vitamin C, Vitamin K, folate (B9), silicon, and plant protein.
cv_pipeline_role: Classified via CNN (228x228) and detected via YOLOv8n bounding boxes for automated harvest and sorting.

visual_features: Globular to top-shaped root with rough reddish-purple to dark crimson skin; intense ruby-red internal flesh with concentric betalain pigment rings.
growth_habit: Basal rosette of dark green ovate leaves with prominent reddish-purple veins arising from swollen crown.
nutritional_profile: High in dietary nitrates, betacyanin antioxidants, folate, manganese, and potassium; supports cardiovascular blood pressure regulation.
cv_pipeline_role: High-contrast color segmentation and shape detection in optical grading lines.

visual_features: Oblong, ridged fruit characterized by prominent warty, bumpy, jagged exterior ridges; bright green when unripe turning yellow-orange with scarlet seeds at maturity.
growth_habit: Rapidly growing herbaceous tendril-bearing vine with deeply lobed 3-7 palmate leaves and solitary yellow flowers.
nutritional_profile: Contains charantin, vicine, and polypeptide-p (insulin-like compounds); widely utilized in anti-diabetic diets and liver detox.
cv_pipeline_role: Distinctive rough surface texture makes it an ideal candidate for texture-based CNN feature maps and YOLO edge detection.

visual_features: Glossy, smooth, deep purple to black-violet pear-shaped or cylindrical fruit topped with a green spiny star-shaped persistent calyx; white spongy internal seed-bearing flesh.
growth_habit: Semi-woody erect bushy plant (60-120 cm) with large lobed coarse leaves and violet star-shaped flowers with yellow stamens.
nutritional_profile: Abundant in nasunin (potent anthocyanin antioxidant in the skin), dietary fiber, potassium, and phenolic compounds.
cv_pipeline_role: High specular reflectivity on skin requires robust lighting normalization during CNN image preprocessing.

visual_features: Dense, spherical or flattened spherical head composed of tightly overlapping, curved, waxy light green to bluish-green leaves with prominent white veins.
growth_habit: Short, thickened stem supporting a massive terminal leafy head surrounded by looser basal spreading outer leaves.
nutritional_profile: Rich in sulfur glucosinolates (sulforaphane), Vitamin C, Vitamin K, and insoluble fiber with known cancer-preventative properties.
cv_pipeline_role: Easily identified in retail and field settings by its spherical bounding box geometry and concentric leaf patterns.

visual_features: Blocky, bell-shaped, 3-4 lobed fruit with thick fleshy walls, glossy smooth skin; colors range from vibrant green (unripe) to bright red, yellow, and orange.
growth_habit: Upright branching bush with shiny ovate leaves and small white single blossoms.
nutritional_profile: Exceptionally high in Vitamin C (surpassing citrus fruits), Vitamin A, carotenoids (capsanthin), and lutein; zero capsaicin heat.
cv_pipeline_role: One of the benchmark classes verified in the repository with 228x228 classification maps and multi-color YOLO bounding boxes.

visual_features: Elongated, tapering conical root with bright orange skin and firm orange xylem/phloem core; topped with feathery pinnate green foliage.
growth_habit: Rosette of finely divided, lace-like compound leaves growing directly from the root shoulder.
nutritional_profile: Premier source of provitamin A (beta-carotene), alpha-carotene, lutein, and dietary pectin; essential for ocular health.
cv_pipeline_role: High aspect ratio bounding boxes in YOLO detection; orientation and root diameter estimation in automated packing.

visual_features: Dense, compact, pebbled head ('curd') composed of tightly clustered cream-white abortive flower buds surrounded by heavy ribbed gray-green jacket leaves.
growth_habit: Stout central stem terminating in a solitary floral curd, protected naturally or artificially by tying wrapper leaves (blanching).
nutritional_profile: Abundant in choline, Vitamin C, Vitamin K, glucosinolates, and dietary fiber; popular low-carb culinary staple.
cv_pipeline_role: Texture recognition algorithms leverage high spatial frequency variations across curd clusters.

visual_features: Cylindrical ear wrapped in pale green fibrous husks; inner ear packed with tight parallel longitudinal rows of plump golden-yellow or white sweet kernels.
growth_habit: Tall erect monocotyledonous stalk (1.5-3 m) with broad strap leaves, male terminal tassels, and female lateral ears with silky styles.
nutritional_profile: High in complex carbohydrates, zeaxanthin, lutein, phosphorus, and B-complex vitamins (thiamine, niacin).
cv_pipeline_role: Kernels and ears detected in agro-food sorting lines, quality defect grading, and ear counting.

visual_features: Extremely long (30-60 cm), pendulous, slender, triangular green ribbed pods with longitudinal grooves, containing winged seeds embedded in spongy pith.
growth_habit: Slender, softwood tree with droopy, fragile branches, tripinnate compound leaves, and fragrant yellowish-white flowers.
nutritional_profile: 'Superfood' loaded with calcium, iron, Vitamin A, Vitamin C, potassium, essential amino acids, and quercetin.
cv_pipeline_role: Included in the custom 20-class CNN classification model (`VC Model.h5`) for South Asian horticultural applications.

visual_features: Subglobose composite bulb covered in thin papery, dry white to purplish tunic scales, encasing 10-20 crescent-shaped individual cloves.
growth_habit: Upright, flat, linear keeled leaves emerging from the basal plate of an underground bulb.
nutritional_profile: High in organosulfur compounds (allicin, alliin, ajoene) with scientifically documented antimicrobial, cardioprotective, and antihypertensive properties.
cv_pipeline_role: Distinctive lobed bulb silhouette detected easily by YOLO bounding boxes in post-harvest sorting bins.

visual_features: Thick, branched, palmate or knotty tuberous rhizome ('hand') with fibrous tan/buff-brown corky skin and pale yellow aromatic, pungent fibrous flesh.
growth_habit: Pseudostems (up to 1 m) formed by overlapping leaf sheaths with lanceolate leaves and sterile cone-like inflorescences.
nutritional_profile: Rich in bioactive gingerol, shogaols, and zingerone providing anti-inflammatory, anti-nausea, and digestive benefits.
cv_pipeline_role: Irregular palmate contour creates unique spatial features for convolutional kernel activation.

visual_features: Slender, elongated, conical pod tapering to a sharp point, shiny deep green skin, calyx crown at stem end, pungent placenta lined with seeds.
growth_habit: Much-branched woody subshrub (40-80 cm) bearing small white axillary flowers and pendulous or upright fruit.
nutritional_profile: High capsaicin content (Scoville heat units), ascorbic acid (Vitamin C), and capsaicinoids that stimulate metabolism.
cv_pipeline_role: Trained specifically in the YOLO detector (`best.pt`) for real-time fresh market sorting.

visual_features: Pentagonal to octagonal fluted green pod tapering to a sharp point; fine fuzzy pubescent hairs on skin; internal chambers containing mucilaginous white seeds.
growth_habit: Stout, erect semi-woody stem (1-2 m) with large lobed leaves and showy yellow hibiscus-like flowers with crimson centers.
nutritional_profile: Abundant soluble mucilage fiber, folate, Vitamin C, Vitamin K, and lutein; beneficial for intestinal glycemic control.
cv_pipeline_role: High aspect ratio detection; cross-sectional ridge pattern readily identified by CNN layers.

visual_features: Ellipsoidal to spherical fruit with a distinct apical nipple, glossy yellow or green glandular skin (flavedo) containing aromatic essential oil glands; pale segmented acidic pulp.
growth_habit: Spreading thorny shrub/tree with shiny ovate leaves, winged petioles, and fragrant white blossoms.
nutritional_profile: High concentration of citric acid, Vitamin C (ascorbic acid), hesperidin, and bioflavonoids.
cv_pipeline_role: Circular bounding box geometry, color thresholding (HSV yellow-green), and circular Hough transform benchmarking.

visual_features: Globular to oblate bulb encased in dry, papery, shiny tunic scales (red, yellow, or white); internal concentric thick succulent fleshy scale layers.
growth_habit: Hollow, cylindrical fistular leaves arising from the underground stem plate, followed in year two by spherical umbels of white flowers.
nutritional_profile: Rich in quercetin (flavonol antioxidant), allicin precursors (S-alk(en)yl-L-cysteine sulfoxides), and fructo-oligosaccharide prebiotics.
cv_pipeline_role: One of the most frequently detected vegetables in industrial sorting conveyors using YOLOv8 bounding boxes.

visual_features: Straight or curved green pods enclosing a single row of 4-10 plump, spherical, bright emerald-green seeds; sweet and tender.
growth_habit: Weak herbaceous stem climbing via leaf-terminal tendrils, with glaucous stipules and white or pink zygomorphic papilionaceous flowers.
nutritional_profile: High protein content among vegetables, high in fiber, Vitamin A, Vitamin C, iron, and saponins.
cv_pipeline_role: Identified either in-pod or as bulk shelled peas in food processing inspection vision stations.

plant_type: Herbaceous Annual with Underground Stem Tubers
visual_features: Round, oval, or oblong starchy tuber with smooth or netted skin (russet, red, yellow) punctuated by dormant buds ('eyes'); firm white, yellow, or cream interior.
growth_habit: Bushy green compound foliage bearing white, pink, or purple star flowers and inedible toxic green seedballs.
nutritional_profile: Primary dietary source of complex starch, Vitamin C, Vitamin B6, potassium (higher than bananas), and resistant starch.
cv_pipeline_role: Core benchmark for grading size, ovality, skin blemishes, greening defects, and weight estimation.

visual_features: Large, round to oblate fruit with deeply ribbed or grooved hard rind (orange, tan, green); thick fibrous orange pulp surrounding a central cavity with hull-less seeds.
growth_habit: Vigorous prostate vines spreading up to 10 m with large prickly palmate leaves and large yellow unisexual trumpet flowers.
nutritional_profile: Loaded with beta-carotene, lutein, zeaxanthin, potassium, and nutrient-dense edible zinc-rich pumpkin seeds (pepitas).
cv_pipeline_role: Trained in the 20-class CNN classifier (`VC Model.h5`) for automated farm market weighing.

visual_features: Globular (round red garden radish) or elongated cylindrical (white Daikon radish) taproot with crisp, peppery white internal flesh; coarse green leaves.
growth_habit: Basal rosette of lyrate-pinnatifid leaves growing rapidly from crown; harvestable in 25-45 days from seeding.
nutritional_profile: Contains pungent glucosinolates, isothiocyanates, Vitamin C, anthocyanins, and digestive diastase enzymes.
cv_pipeline_role: Dual-color (red skin / white flesh) visual signatures detected accurately by both CNN and YOLO models.

visual_features: Slender, glossy, elongated pod maturing from green to brilliant crimson or fire-red; high concentration of fiery capsaicin oil droplets in internal placenta.
growth_habit: Woody base bush with dense canopy, dark green leaves, and pendulous ripening red pods.
nutritional_profile: Highest concentration of capsaicin, capsanthin carotenoids, Vitamin A, and antioxidant flavonoids.
cv_pipeline_role: YOLO detection model specifically discriminates between `Green Chilli` and `Red Chilli` based on HSV spectral bands.

visual_features: Globose to oblate fleshy berry, glossy red or yellow-orange skin at maturity; multi-locular seed cavities filled with gelatinous pulp and seeds; aromatic calyx.
growth_habit: Determinate (bush) or indeterminate (vining climbing) hairy glandular stems with distinct pungent foliar scent and yellow 5-petaled flowers.
nutritional_profile: Foremost dietary source of lycopene (prostate and cardiovascular protective carotenoid), Vitamin C, potassium, and folate.
cv_pipeline_role: Shared cornerstone class across plant disease detection, vegetable classification, and real-time YOLO object detection.
